caption: The drawing features three detailed renderings of a rectangular buckle. The uppermost buckle is completed in color with a metallic gold and silver appearance; it has a rectangular frame lined with circular, pearl-like studs along the entire edge. The prongs and crossbars of the buckle are drawn in brown and gold tones. Below this, there is an outlined sketch of the same buckle without any coloring, showing only the structural lines and the scalloped outer edge. To the right of this sketch, there is a partial, curved section of the buckle again drawn only in pencil, focusing on the frame and a row of the circular studs. In the upper-left corner, an ornate, golden linear decorative element extends partially into the scene from the edge. The background is an off-white or light beige color.
title: Shoe Buckle
